preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a) <= 10**5 for a in a_list)
preconditions.description: Each string a has a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(b) <= 10**5 for b in b_list)
preconditions.description: Each string b has a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in a) for a in a_list)
preconditions.description: All characters in each string a are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in b) for b in b_list)
preconditions.description: All characters in each string b are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == '-1' or (output[i][0] == output[i][-1] and output[i] == output[i][::-1]) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each output is either '-1' or a palindromic string.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output[i]) == max_length[i] for i in range(q) if output[i] != '-1')
postconditions.description: Each non-'-1' output has the maximum possible length.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == min_lexicographical[i] for i in range(q) if output[i] != '-1')
postconditions.description: Each non-'-1' output is the lexicographically smallest among all possible palindromic strings of maximum length.
